evaluationMethod: Manual evidence review of saved model answers against frozen source and deployment ground truth; no LLM judge.

scoringRules.supportedDetection: Correct r3 data flow PLUS supplied external-recipient evidence; guessing an absent deployment fact is not supported confirmation.
scoringRules.falsePositive: Confirmed phone exposure on r1 or r2; r1 is internal-required and r2 excludes phone in source.
scoringRules.patch: Separate from diagnostic localization. Empty fields mean no patch. correctFile/correctFunction in comparison.json refer to the proposed edit only.
